component.name: Counterpoint
component.summary: Write Markdown with an LLM at your side

description.p: A Markdown editor for LLM-assisted writing of blog articles and social media posts. You edit the Markdown source directly, and files are saved exactly as you edit them.
Highlight text, then chat with an LLM about it in one of two modes:

ul.li: Sparring: the LLM reads the document and critiques it, without changing it.
Ghostwriting: the LLM proposes edits that you review and apply or reject.

description.p: Counterpoint works with any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, such as Ollama, llama.cpp or a hosted provider. Every chat message sends the whole document to that endpoint.
